entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who has come to Innistrad to find Sorin Markov, and seeks Liliana's help to do so.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker with violet eyes who lives in a manor on Innistrad guarded by zombie servants; she warns Jace off his search for Sorin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient vampire planeswalker, the so-called Lord of Innistrad, who helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and is now missing.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who left Ravnica with Jace and took an oath to keep going after interplanar threats.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A gothic plane of werewolves, vampires, zombies and angels, where Jace arrived two days ago and already hates.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A mountainous province of Innistrad that Jace crosses on the way to Liliana's manor.

entities.name: Liliana's Manor
entities.description: A large manor with a newer stone tower crowned by a metal apparatus, lit by eerie purple glow, guarded by zombies; Liliana's home on Innistrad.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's ancestral home on Innistrad, where he has not been welcome for hundreds of years.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Jace left, leaving unfinished business with Liliana.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where three planeswalkers trapped the Eldrazi and where Jace and others later released them.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Extraplanar, world-devouring monstrosities trapped on Zendikar by three planeswalkers, one of them Sorin, and later released.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose krasis experiments Jace compares to werewolves.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact that Liliana still has.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Human-wolf predators of Innistrad; one of them is Jace's guide, who transforms and leads a pack against him.

entities.name: Zombies
entities.description: Mindless dead who serve Liliana, guarding her manor and serving as her servants.

events.summary: Jace rides toward Stensia with a silent guide, complaining about Liliana and about needing her help.
events.quote: The jagged mountains of the province called Stensia loomed ahead of them

events.summary: Jace's guide transforms into a werewolf.
events.quote: His guide turned to him, accompanied by the stomach-churning sounds of bones cracking and clothes tearing.

events.summary: The werewolf kills its horse as Jace flees; howls answer from the woods.
events.quote: Behind him, the horse's scream was cut short with a wet crunch.

events.summary: A pack of werewolves chases Jace toward the manor.
events.quote: There were at least three of them bounding after him, hideous amalgamations of human and wolf.

events.summary: Jace conjures a solid illusory bear that tackles one werewolf.
events.quote: A hulking bear made of shining blue light took form behind him

events.summary: Jace takes control of his guide's mind briefly, making it attack the pack's alpha, so the wolves fight each other.
events.quote: At last, the connection was complete. Jace was in control.

events.summary: A werewolf kills Jace's horse at the manor gate and Jace rolls clear.
events.quote: He was within shouting distance of the gate when the werewolf struck.

events.summary: Jace picks the lock on the manor gate with telekinesis and slips inside, and the werewolf leaves.
events.quote: Invisible mental fingers felt around inside the lock, found the tumblers, and quickly twirled them into place.

events.summary: Mindless zombies surround Jace in the yard, then part to let him pass into the house.
events.quote: In the darkness of the manor's yard, he could just barely make out a dozen figures standing silently around him.

events.summary: Jace is led to Liliana, who greets him and flicks his nose to check he came in person.
events.quote: She reached up to his face...and flicked the tip of his nose.

events.summary: Liliana disdainfully says there is worse than werewolves out there: angels.
events.quote: "Angels," she said with disgust.

events.summary: Jace claims he came to apologize for leaving Ravnica with unfinished business.
events.quote: I'm here to apologize.

events.summary: Jace tells Liliana he and Gideon saved a plane and took an oath to keep fighting interplanar threats.
events.quote: We even took an oath, to...to keep doing this.

events.summary: Liliana sees through Jace and refuses his freely given aid, forcing him to admit he needs something.
events.quote: I refuse your freely given aid, Jace Beleren.

events.summary: Jace reveals he is looking for Sorin Markov, surprising Liliana.
events.quote: I'm looking for Sorin Markov,

events.summary: Jace explains that Sorin helped trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar and that Jace and two other planeswalkers inadvertently freed them (recounted).
events.quote: Manipulated and coerced, two other Planeswalkers and I inadvertently released the Eldrazi titans from their prison.

events.summary: Liliana recalls her one meeting with Sorin long ago, when he tested and dismissed her and warned her to be a civil guest (recounted).
events.quote: He sought me out, tested my strength in battle, and pronounced me too weak to be a threat.

events.summary: Liliana warns Jace not to seek Sorin, saying he is ancient, ruthless and powerful.
events.quote: And I am telling you, don't go.

events.summary: Liliana warns that Markov Manor is even worse, but Jace insists it is his best lead.
events.quote: Markov Manor is the best lead I have.

events.summary: Liliana sets her zombie servants on Jace to make a point.
events.quote: Her zombie servants lurched forward.

events.summary: Jace's illusions and spells fail against the mindless dead and he is held helpless against the wall.
events.quote: Jace was helpless.

events.summary: Liliana tells Jace the world is dangerous, then releases him and tells him to go home.
events.quote: Undead hands released him, and he rose, rubbing his throat.

events.summary: Liliana tells Jace to stay the night rather than leave, then teases him that indifference would not quicken his heartbeat.
events.quote: doesn't make your heartbeat quicken or your face flush.

relations.note: Former companions with unresolved personal history; Liliana betrayed him and the two tease and spar.
relations.quote: Now that we both know exactly how much our personal history means to us

relations.note: Liliana still has the Chain Veil.
relations.quote: I still have the Chain Veil.

relations.note: They saved a plane together and took an oath to keep fighting interplanar threats.
Called the so-called Lord of Innistrad.
One of three planeswalkers who trapped the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
relations.quote: Sorin was one of the three.

relations.note: His ancestral home, but he has been unwelcome there for centuries.
relations.quote: He hasn't been welcome in Markov Manor for hundreds of years at least.
handed it to one of her undead servants.
